format: html

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}
pakistan_cars <- read_csv("pakwheels_used_cars_2026_clean.csv")
cities_pop <- read_csv("cities_population.csv")
```


```{r}
write_csv(pakistan_cars, "pakistan_cars.csv")
```


```{r}
clean_cars <- pakistan_cars |> 
  rename(
    price_usd = price_pkr,
    mileage = mileage_km
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    price_usd = round(price_usd * 0.0036, 0),
    mileage = round(mileage * 0.621371, 0)
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(mileage),
         !is.na(engine_cc),
         !is.na(fuel_type)) |> 
  select(-mileage_flag,
         -engine_cc_flag,
         -link,
         -scraped_at) |> 
  mutate(
    vehicle_age = 2026 - `year`,
    log_price = log(price_usd),
    log_mileage = log(mileage)
  )


clean_cars_pop <- clean_cars |> 
  left_join(cities_pop, join_by(city == City))

```



```{r}
write_csv(clean_cars, "clean_cars.csv")
write_csv(clean_cars_pop, "clean_cars_pop.csv")
```




```{r}
clean_cars |> 
  filter(city %in% c("Karachi", "Lahore", "Faisalabad", "Rawalpindi", "Gujranwala", "Multan", "Hyderabad", "Peshawar")) |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(x = log_mileage, y = log_price)
  ) +
  geom_point(color = "green") +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~city)
```
